条目池说明: The Entry Pool is the core data source for action options. Manage configs and the master entry pool here. Bind a config to a character or chat, and entries will be drawn from it during generation.
配置说明: Configs are reusable entry sets that can be bound to characters or chats. Switch the dropdown to edit different configs. Use the star button to set as default, and the chat/user buttons to bind/unbind to the current chat or character.
新手步骤1: Open the Entry Pool and add your action option entries (or use AI Generate)
新手步骤2: Create a new config and give it a name (e.g. "Combat", "Daily Chat")
新手步骤3: In the config, click "Add Entry" and select entries from the master pool
新手步骤4: Bind the config to a character or chat — it will take effect on next generation
新手提示: Tip: Chat binding has the highest priority, followed by character binding. If neither is bound, the default config is used.
条目库说明: The Master Pool is the central repository of all entries. Configs reference entries from here. Modifying the master pool will affect all configs that use the modified entries. Group entries by category, drag to reorder.
提示词说明: Prompts determine the style and quality of generated options. This is a modular system: each module maps to a role (system/user/assistant). Drag to reorder, double-click to rename, use the toolbar to add modules.
模块说明: Modules are the basic units of the prompt. Drag ☰ to reorder, double-click the name to rename. Supports system/user/assistant roles. Locked modules are system-managed and cannot be edited.
上下文说明: Context rounds control how many messages of history are sent to the AI. "Rounds mode" takes the last N rounds, "Visible only" excludes hidden messages. Prefill sends an assistant message to guide the output format.
过滤说明: Chat history filtering removes redundant content (chain-of-thought, mini-theater, etc.) before sending to the AI, improving generation quality.
API说明: Configure the API used for generating options. Supports multiple API configs — switch via the dropdown. Changes are not auto-saved; click the Save button to persist.
API保存提示: API config changes are not auto-saved. Please click the Save button.
选项规则说明: Controls option generation behavior. Auto-generate triggers automatically after an AI reply. Input Enrich rewrites user input into multiple polished versions.
规则说明: Narrative style and option rules are the content of the core_rules module, directly injected into the prompt to guide the AI.
润色说明: Input Enrich: before sending a message, the AI rewrites the user input into multiple polished versions to choose from. The number on the right is how many versions to generate.
世界书说明: Controls whether world info entries are injected into the option generation prompt. Enabled by default with character and global world books. Uncheck to exclude specific books or entries.
外观说明: Controls the extension's appearance. The floating bubble provides a quick-access button in the bottom-right corner. Supports dark/light theme, transparency, and font size.
AI生成条目说明: Let the AI generate a batch of entries based on your requirements. Specify count, requirements, target group, and optionally include recent chat context. Check the entries you want to inject into the master pool.
粘贴导入说明: Paste text from clipboard, one entry per line. Supports 1. / - / • list markers. Parsed results are deduplicated and empty lines are removed. Import into a specific group or uncategorized.
